chunks: Al-Ḥalabī narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام that he was asked about breaking the fast before the salat (prayer) or after it. He said:

“If he is with a group and fears that he may keep them waiting from their dinner, then let him break his fast with them. But if it is otherwise, then let him perform the salat (prayer), then break his fast.”

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: the ritual salat (prayer) performed at its time
key_terms.فَلْيُفْطِرْ: then he should break the fast
key_terms.قَوْمٌ: a group of people present with him
key_terms.يَخْشَى: he fears or anticipates a difficulty

ai.seo_question: Should a fasting person break the fast before maghrib prayer or pray first?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a practical ruling on whether one should break the fast before or after salat (prayer) at sunset. If others would be inconvenienced by delay, one may break the fast with them first; otherwise, one should perform salat (prayer) before eating.
